messages:
Nia (Design): Spike: proposing a small-screen axis mode that strips per-tick units, keeps a single unit header, and surfaces a compact spike badge instead of re-scaling charts. Want opinions on detection and a11y.

Rahul (PM): Sounds promising for dense dashboards. Concern: detection ruleswill determine trust. Can we avoid surprises for SREs who rely on visual amplitude?

Iris (Viz): Idea: two-layer render: raw line (low alpha) + smoothed overlay. Use robust z-score for outlier detection: z = (v - median)/MAD, mark if z > 4. For small isolated blips mark with a tiny badge and tooltip; if consecutive outliers >=3 treat as sustained and emphasize.

Jon (Frontend): Implementation sketch: chart.mode = "condensed" | "normal". In condensed: show only 2 ticks, unit as axis-caption aria-labelled. Add badge component anchored to chart top-right: "+3 spikes" clickable to expand to full axis. Will prototype using WebGL layer for badges.

Elena (A11y): Copy suggestion: label the control "Show detailed axis" instead of 'expand'. Keyboard interaction: toggle reveals full tick list in an accessible table format. Screen reader announcement for badges should be "3 notable spikes detected between <time> and <time>". Also ensure badge color passes contrast and doesn't rely on color alone.

Nia (Design): Visual note: use low-contrast dotted smoothing line, full-opacity raw behind it. Badge: 10px pill, subtle chevron, hover reveals list of spike times. For micro-annotations on points, prefer stroke+fill to be visible on dark and light themes.

Iris (Viz): Smoothing parameter proposal: apply Hampel or EWMA only inside the 1.5*IQR window; alpha default 0.2. Also offer a user preference to disable smoothing per panel.

Jon (Frontend): Pseudo:
```
const isOutlier = (v, median, mad) => Math.abs((v - median)/mad) > 4;
if (isOutlier(v)) drawBadge(point);
else addToSmoother(point);
```
Canvas + WebGL combo for perf.

Rahul (PM): Rollout idea: opt-in for beta orgs, then feature flag chart.condensed_axis to pilot. Product metric: percent of users who expand axis after seeing badge.

infra-bot: Feature flag "chart.condensed_axis" created in staging.

Elena (A11y): Also request test cases for NVDA/VoiceOver: ensure keyboard focus order includes badge, expand control, and the expanded tick table.

Nia (Design): Action items: Jon to drop prototype, Iris to produce 3 example datasets (sparse spikes, noisy baseline, sustained trend), Elena to write accessibility checks, Rahul to own pilot plan. Check back in 72h.

Jon (Frontend): Prototype started, expecting Figma + demo by EOD tomorrow.

Iris (Viz): I'll upload CSVs to the design board today.

Rahul (PM): Thanks team. Excited to validate this on mobile dashboards! :rocket:
